name: Postiz — AI per-platform captions (blog → Claude → schedule)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.AI_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 300, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are a social media copywriter for cloudless.gr, a cloud services company in Greece. Write a ' + $json.platform + ' post promoting this blog article. Title: "' + $json.title + '". Content summary: ' + $json.text.substring(0, 1500) + '

Rules:
- ' + ($json.platform === 'x' ? 'Max 280 chars. Punchy, 1-2 hashtags.' : $json.platform === 'linkedin' || $json.platform === 'linkedin-page' ? '2-3 paragraphs, professional tone, 3-5 hashtags. Include a call-to-action.' : $json.platform === 'instagram' || $json.platform === 'threads' ? 'Casual, engaging, use emojis, 5-10 hashtags at end.' : $json.platform === 'bluesky' ? 'Max 300 chars, conversational, 1-2 hashtags.' : 'Medium length, engaging, 2-3 hashtags.') + '
- Language: ' + ($json.locale === 'el' ? 'Greek' : 'English') + '
- Do NOT include the URL (it is added automatically).
- Output ONLY the post text, no explanation.' }] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'draft', posts: [{ integration: { id: $json.channelId }, value: [{ content: $json.caption, image: [] }], settings: { __type: $json.platform } }] }) }}
